name: CST2010-200LD
title: CST2010 surface-mount current sense transformers, 1:20 to 1:200, 47 A
summary: A family of eleven ferrite-core current sense transformers for surface mounting, qualified to AEC-Q200 Grade 1. The primary is a single turn between two large terminals (pins 11 and 12) with 0.36 mΩ maximum resistance; the secondary, between pins 2 and 4, has from 20 to 200 turns depending on the model. With a terminating resistor across the secondary it turns a primary current of up to 47 A into a voltage, over a frequency range that reaches above 1 MHz. The windings are isolated from each other to 1500 Vrms for one minute. The CST2010-200LD is the 1:200 model on a full reel.

notes: Inductance is taken across the secondary pins at 1 kHz and 0.1 Vrms with no DC current.
The volt-time product applies to the secondary, from pin 2 to pin 4.

circuits.title: Typical circuit
circuits.description: The current to be measured, Iin, passes through the one-turn primary from pin 11 to pin 12. The secondary of N turns drives a current Iout through the terminating resistor RT, which is connected straight across pins 2 and 4, and the voltage across RT is the output, positive at the pin 2 end. RT is chosen from the part's turns ratio: the listed value for each model gives 1 V at 40 A, and for the 1:200 model it is 5.0 Ω.

operation.text: Primary current is what warms the part. Near 47 A the rise above a 25°C ambient is about 40°C, and the ambient plus this rise must stay within the +165°C part temperature limit.
Pins 11 and 2 carry the winding dots: current entering pin 11 makes pin 2 the positive end of the output across RT.
